sloka: स यातः तेजसा व्योम संक्षिपन् इव वेगतः ।अथ अहम् खे चरैः भूतैः अभिगम्य सभाजितः ॥४-५९-१७॥
transliteration: sa yātaḥ tejasā vyoma saṁkṣipan iva vegataḥ ।atha aham khe caraiḥ bhūtaiḥ abhigamya sabhājitaḥ ॥4-59-17॥

translations.english: 'He flew hurriedly with splendour as though he was enveloping the sky (making it small). All the flying creatures in the sky came and greeted me with respect.
